The closing ring separates a note gesture from a fill, giving you time to choose.

title.en: Fill a cell with one note
title.es: Rellenar una celda con una nota
title.zh-Hans: 填写只剩一个笔记的格子
title.zh-Hant: 填寫只剩一個筆記的格子

tips.description: Use this when a cell has only one remaining note.
Green is a forced-move hint available in Chill mode, not a guess.
Clearing a fill brings its notes back so you can reconsider the cell.
A highlight helps you follow one label across the board, including its notes and fills.

title.en: Drag a digit onto the board

tips.description: You can enter a fill from the panel without opening the direction wheel.
The panel edits the selected cell’s notes. Choosing a different cell changes what it shows.

title.en: Fill and clear through the panel
title.es: Rellenar y borrar desde el panel

tips.description: The panel can fill or clear the selected cell while the other cells stay unchanged.

title.en: Try a copy of the board

tips.description: Trying a guess on a copy leaves your original board unchanged.
Compare another board’s deductions with your notes through its coloured marks.

title.en: Rule out a note with two tries
title.es: Descartar una nota con dos pruebas

tips.description: Try both possible places for a label. A note ruled out in both copies can be removed from the original.
Discarding a try board keeps the other boards and their work.
Fire fills one proved cell; it does not choose a guess for you.
Ice fills the current proved cells together. Those fills do not start another wave.
Each Lightning wave can prove more cells, which the next wave fills.

title.zh-Hans: 在确定状态下显示强制走法
title.zh-Hant: 在確定狀態下顯示強制走法

tips.description: Definite means at least one set has only one choice left. Tap the status pill to highlight these enforced moves one by one.

title.en: Show the tightest sets in Dilemma
title.es: Mostrar los grupos más limitados en Dilema
title.zh-Hans: 在困境状态下显示选择最少的集合
title.zh-Hant: 在困境狀態下顯示選擇最少的集合

tips.description: Dilemma means no move is enforced. Tap the status pill to highlight the sets with the fewest choices left. This example has two choices in each highlighted set.

title.en: Focus on errors one by one

tips.description: Tap Invalid to highlight each error in turn.
Undo and Redo work on notes and fills. Use them to recheck the last change.
A Dilemma has no forced move left. It is where you choose what to try next.
Revisit the opening board without resetting the puzzle or losing its recorded moves.
A digit repeats in a row, column or box. Red corners mark your conflicting fills. Here, row 1 has two 1s, at columns 4 and 7.
Your fills and notes leave no label that can fill this cell. At row 1, column 1, dashed red boxes mark all nine labels as missing.
Your fills and notes leave no place for a label in a row. Row 1 is outlined in red. Dashed red boxes mark 1 in every empty cell, showing the missing label.
Your fills and notes leave no place for a label in a box. The top-left box is outlined in red. Dashed red boxes mark 3 in every empty cell, showing the missing label.
Your fills and notes leave no place for a label in a column. Column 1 is outlined in red. Dashed red boxes mark 2 in every empty cell, showing the missing label.
Two forced moves conflict in the same cell. A red frame outlines row 1, column 1; solid red boxes mark the competing notes 4 and 7.
Two forced moves conflict in the same row. A red frame outlines row 1; solid red boxes mark the competing 1s in columns 2 and 4.
Two forced moves conflict in the same box. A red frame outlines the top-left box; solid red boxes mark the competing 3s at row 2, column 1 and row 3, column 2.
Two forced moves conflict in the same column. A red frame outlines column 1; solid red boxes mark the competing 1s in rows 1 and 8.
If these fills were right, we'd get two answers. We detect only some swaps: red circles mark 1s and 4s; thin lines link circled cells in two sets; chevrons show the sets can swap.
